title: Six Planks
subtitle: 木板与板子 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 木板与板子（生活与学习·器物与工具）
meta: 主题语境：木板与板子（生活与学习·器物与工具）　|　核心词汇：board　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 board 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 my father was sent to plane ① a board he could not lift, and he said the lifting was the whole of the lesson. The ② board, meaning the plank and not the notice, was six planks wide and was carried by whoever came last; a board, he said, is the only thing in a shed that is judged by how much has been taken off it.

Every ③ board in that shed had the same grain, and the ④ board at the back, meaning the one the notice was nailed to and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever planed properly. A board, my grandmother said, is nine parts timber and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my father said the timber is the part that gets everywhere.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ board was the whole of the meeting, meaning the committee and not the plank. The ⑥ board, meaning the committee and not any of that, is the only thing in a company that everybody elects and nobody questions; a board, she said, is either something you plane or the only word that means both a plank and a committee. He said the committee is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ board had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the timber. The ⑧ board of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was six planks of pine and eleven years of lifting; a board, she said, is either the plank at the back or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ board I remember is the one at the back, which was replaced in 1971 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ board, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being planed; every board, she said, is a committee that has agreed to look like a plank. She said the committee was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 木板（指那块板，与通知相对）
C. 固定搭配：plane a board 刨一块木板
D. n. 木板（指棚屋里每一块）
E. n. 木板（指后面钉通知的那一块）
F. n. 董事会；委员会（抽象：与木板相对）
G. n. 委员会（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a board he could not lift
The board, meaning the plank and not the notice
board was the whole of the meeting
the board had become a photograph in a report
The board of the whole thing
A board, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: plane a board 意为“刨一块木板”，1948 年父亲被派去刨一块他抬不动的木板。
board 意为“木板”，指那块板而不是通知，宽六块板，由最后走的人抬走。
board 指棚屋里每一块木板，每一块都是同样的纹理。
board 指后面那一块（钉通知的那一块），是唯一有人认真刨过的。
board 意为“董事会、委员会”，与木板相对，母亲说 board 就是那场会议的全部。
board 为抽象用法，指委员会这件事本身，是公司里人人都选举、却没人质疑的东西。
board 意为“木板、板子”，到 1966 年这块 board 成了报告里的一张照片。
board 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是六块松木和十一年的抬动。
board 意为“木板”，我记得的是后面那一块，1971 年被换掉，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
board 为抽象总称，祖母说木板是唯一会因为被刨平而变好的东西。
